_comment: MP-042 model-pin manifest. Single source of truth for 'which Ollama model drives which job', so a job fails loud on drift instead of silently skipping (the problem MP-042/#187 describes). Validate with scripts/check_model_pins.py.
_scope: The in_game block below is READ-ONLY documentation — ModelConfig.java (src/main/java/com/mindpalace/agent/ModelConfig.java) is the actual source of truth for those roles; this file only mirrors it so the validator can catch the two drifting apart. The cron_jobs block is the part this file actually governs, but it's a PROPOSED CONTRACT, not yet wired into any local cron/Task Scheduler entry outside this repo -- Hermes' own scheduler needs to be pointed at it for the pin to take effect. See docs/MODEL_PINS.md. LIVE-4 UPDATE (2026-11-20, t_9bc9210e): Hermes cron jobs now carry per-job pinned provider/model in the Hermes scheduler itself (hermes cron job model/provider fields) and are audited every 15 min by the cron_status_watchdog (AIGEN_SYS/reports/cron_status.json, noncompliant_model must stay 0); the authorized pair for enabled Hermes LLM jobs is ollama-cloud/glm-5.3-flash per the Architect's 2026-10-11 scope ruling. The cron_jobs block below is superseded for Hermes-side jobs — it stays for the in-repo contract shape; see docs/CRON_PROVIDER_REGISTRY.md for the real per-job list.
